compiled_state.title: As a reconciler operator, I want a residual-reference sweep for retired bridge artifacts (bridge_state/, prev_snapshot, mapping.json)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Repo-hygiene story paired with draft-2 atomic-deletion blast radius. Exhaustive ripgrep + Glob inventory of every reference to retired bridge artifacts across scripts, workflows, hooks, docs, tests. Classify each match as remove/redirect/document-as-historical. Validate no .github/workflows/ file still reads/writes retired paths (CI guard). Update CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md. Verify bridge_alerts mechanism preserved or migrated with smoke test.
**Why**: Epic declares 'Stateless — no bridge_state/, no prev_snapshot, no mapping.json' but no story owns consumer enumeration. Unmigrated consumers will silently degrade.
**Scope**:
- IN: ripgrep + Glob inventory, classification table, workflows scan + CI guard, config doc update, bridge_alerts compat smoke test
- OUT: Re-introduction of any retired state path; new bridge_alerts features

## Done Definitions

- ripgrep + Glob inventory of every reference to 'bridge_state', 'prev_snapshot', 'mapping.json' across the repo (scripts, workflows, hooks, docs, tests) is committed as an audit artifact ← Satisfies: sc-1, sc-2
- Each reference in the inventory is classified as one of {remove, redirect, document-as-historical}; classification table committed alongside inventory ← Satisfies: sc-2
- .github/workflows/ scan confirms no workflow reads or writes the retired paths; a unit test or CI check enforces this ← Satisfies: sc-2
- plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md is updated to remove or annotate retired keys (e.g., BRIDGE_ENV_ID semantics around prev_snapshot) ← Satisfies: sc-2
- bridge_alerts mechanism is verified compatible with stateless reconciler — either preserved with new wiring or explicitly migrated; smoke test confirms bridge_alerts still surfaces ← Satisfies: sc-2
- Unit tests written and passing for all new logic ← Validates Closure Check: "TDD DoD"

## Considerations

- [Risk] Documentation references that survive migration become orphan knowledge — be aggressive about removing or annotating.
- [Operational] bridge_alerts is the only consumer-facing signal from the old bridge; a regression here is high-visibility.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
